CRAB COCONUT - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run CrabCoconut.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
Move Left / Right to bounce the coconut with your claws. Where it hits changes its rebound angle.
Break the random rain of shells before they descend to the sand.
Shells arrive individually at varied positions, intervals and falling speeds.
Missing the coconut or letting a shell reach the crab ends the run.
Controls: LEFT / RIGHT keyboard arrows; P2: A / D.
X / Z / C / V or a gamepad face button starts from the title; natural directions also start.
Enter starts, pauses and resumes. Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause.
After results, X / gamepad A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
P2 keyboard: H joins, G leaves, T Start, R Select. Up to four gamepads work.
All players use the same full-size crab and share a full-screen court and the same shells. Each crab returns
its own coconut; coloured ball outlines match the player colours.
Ball speed starts gently and increases smoothly over the first two minutes.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Widescreen: the picture follows the shape of the window (drag its edges or go
fullscreen: a wider window shows more of the beach). To fix it: --width 427
(16:9), --width 520 (phones), or --aspect 4:3 for the classic 320x240.
Best scores are saved to crabcoconut.srm next to the executable.
